target_customer: Defense, aerospace and industrial distributors and OEMs handling quote to cash and procurement
problem: Quoting and procurement run across emails, ERPs, portals and spreadsheets, slowing responses to DoD RFQs and delivery of critical parts.
business_model: B2B SaaS with embedded forward-deployed engineers
product_category: AI procurement and quote workflow for defense supply chain

founders.name: Nelson Ray
founders.background_notes: Described on YC page as full-stack and sales.

founders.name: Maciej Szymczyk
education: UC Berkeley, EECS, Business Administration and Mathematics, on a Rafal Brzoska Foundation scholarship

competitors.name: GovDash
competitors.what: AI platform for winning government contracts

technical_complexity.rationale: Unifying unstructured email, portal and ERP data into quote workflows using LLMs is standard AI engineering with integration effort.

defensibility.rationale: Embedded deployments in customer workflows create integration lock-in; core AI is replicable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquisition or copy found by late 2026; the company grew to about 30 people.

market_need_then: Defense budgets and supply chain pressure in 2024 and 2025 and manual RFQ response processes in a fragmented supplier base.

identity.voice_and_tone: Patriotic, mission framing: the West's advantage depends on supply chains that work

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable defense-themed name but the Sales prefix undersells the later supply chain positioning; no press on the brand itself.

pivots.from: Helping manufacturers win DoD RFQ solicitations
pivots.to: Supply chain superintelligence for distribution, OEM and procurement
pivots.why: Not stated; positioning shift visible between YC profile and later descriptions.

outcome_analysis: SalesPatriot started in 2024 helping defense suppliers respond to DoD RFQs and raised a $5M seed led by CRV in October 2025, growing to about 30 people. Tailwinds in defense procurement and a team with technical depth drove the raise; it remains active and expanding toward aviation and Europe, so the final outcome is open.
notes: Company website fetch was blocked by a rate-limited safety check.
